title: PAUSE KEY LINE FITS AT TEXT SIZE 2.0
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: at Text size 2.0 on a 1920x1080 screen the pause box key line ran off the right edge: 'ENTER equip from backpack' ended at 1964 of 1920. Each entry is a no-wrap piece, but as an inline piece a long one that starts near the line end still runs on past it instead of moving to the next line. Proven in headless Chromium at a true 1920x1080 after three steps of Text size from a fresh profile (menu size 2.17). Each piece is now an inline block, so a piece that does not fit moves down whole; with that the line stays inside the key box (measured: nothing past the edge).
now: At the largest Text size the pause box key list no longer runs off the right edge of the screen.
